scope: Free motion research and local original-source previews only. No retarget, new action, runtime integration, purchase or source redistribution.
selected_direction: Two hands, a heavy tool at the end of a staff; no kung-fu staff flourishes or one-handed spear style.

candidates.source: Kevin Iglesias Human Melee Animations FREE
candidates.evidence: Downloaded official free Godot/Unreal ZIP; original female action rendered front-oblique and side at every second frame (1–43, 30fps).
candidates.observed: Two-handed pullback, forward thrust with a step, recovery to guard.
candidates.adaptation: Reduce anticipation and foot excursion; create a repeatable thrust/retract segment and an interruptible exit; fit existing right-above-left grip.
candidates.status: Strong source candidate, not yet a rapid channel loop.

candidates.clip: Great Sword Slash / Great Sword Low Slash
candidates.evidence: Official catalogue description and its 18-frame animated preview inspected.
candidates.adaptation: Reduce crouch and shoulder-height windup; author the tool arc to the forward semicircle. Preserve two-hand grip.
candidates.status: Preview-verified candidate; FBX not downloaded or retargeted.

candidates.evidence: Official catalogue description and its 18-frame animated preview inspected; two hands and a body turn.
candidates.adaptation: Extract the rotation, remove run entry/travel, lower the tool path; keep foot pivots to avoid torso-only twisting.
candidates.status: Preview-verified candidate; FBX not downloaded or retargeted.

candidates.source: Existing project two-hand guard plus authored adaptation
candidates.status: No exact free sustained-contact clip verified.
candidates.adaptation: Short entry into a braced forward hold, bounded cutting/weight-shift loop, and an interruptible recovery. Keep the tool in contact instead of repeating a full slash.

excluded.source: Previously proposed paid anime spear / Staff Warrior
excluded.reason: User found the demonstrated styles unsuitable; not selected.

excluded.evidence: Downloaded official free Standard ZIP (CC0), rendered imported original GLB.
excluded.reason: Observed one-hand motion or separated hands; not a direct match for fixed two-hand staff grip.

excluded.source: Kevin Iglesias Human Melee Animations FREE
excluded.reason: A diagonal cut, not an exact forward semicircle. Retained only as an alternative body-weight reference.

limits: Source .blend prints two IK dependency-cycle warnings in Blender 5.1.1. These previews do not certify the source rig; use verified baked curves and recheck hand/weapon contact during retargeting.
Original source files stay under gitignored local/. No raw animation files are prepared for public redistribution.
No purchase, gameplay timing, attack-speed values or damage rules have been selected.
